card.name: Small linking words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as for, against, of, a or if in dosing and caution instructions, often right before a duration, an activity, or a condition. Also fires partway through some drug names.

modes.label: Duration link
modes.description: The word for introduces how long something continues after an event, such as leaving an area.
modes.example: continuing the same weekly dose while in the endemic area, and<< for>> 4 weeks after leaving the endemic area

modes.label: Caution or indication link
modes.description: A preposition follows a caution or indication phrase and leads into an activity or condition.
modes.example: patients should be warned of this possibility and cautioned<< against>> driving a car or operating dangerous machinery.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: The pole fires partway through a drug name such as promethazine or metoclopramide.
